author: bizzard
quote: 0/10 – Woke feminist garbage that ruined the franchise.Rockstar completely lost its edge and turned GTA VI into preachy, feminist nonsense. Jason is an absolute spineless, braindead doormat who just mumbles and gets bossed around the entire time. As for Lucia, she is so insufferable and poorly written that you literally want to shoot her the very second she appears on screen. Skip this disaster.
